mapper.insert: INSERT INTO decision_feedback(decision_id, actual_alert, reviewer, remark, create_time, log_content, log_level, log_template, model_confidence, is_trained) VALUES(#{decisionId}, #{actualAlert}, #{reviewer}, #{remark}, NOW(), #{logContent}, #{logLevel}, #{logTemplate}, #{modelConfidence}, #{isTrained}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE actual_alert = VALUES(actual_alert), reviewer = VALUES(reviewer), remark = VALUES(remark), create_time = NOW(), log_content = VALUES(log_content), log_level = VALUES(log_level), log_template = VALUES(log_template), model_confidence = VALUES(model_confidence), is_trained = VALUES(is_trained)
mapper.select: SELECT id, decision_id, actual_alert, reviewer, remark, create_time, log_content, log_level, log_template, model_confidence, is_trained FROM decision_feedback WHERE is_trained = 0 OR is_trained IS NULL ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
